account.proton.me.note: signed out, the theme menu (Light, Dark, Auto) writes theme as a number: 2 light, 1 dark (Carbon), 0 Auto (follows the system live); absent, the page is light even on a dark system; client JS applies it, no reload; mail, calendar and drive.proton.me redirect here signed out; the signup page is always light (Storefront)

alternativeto.net.note: next-themes, light when absent and the system scheme ignored; the theme toggle writes theme

de.wikipedia.org.note: signed out, the Appearance menu writes the host-only cookie dewikimwclientpreferences; an inline head script reads it, no reload
the cookie lists several client prefs (%2C); only the day theme is swapped

demo.home-assistant.io.note: the demo's mock backend reads demo_theme as JSON, {"theme":"default","dark":false} (light) when absent, even on a dark system; without a dark key the theme is Auto: dark under a dark system, following it live; the theme menu writes it, no reload

docs.python.org.note: _static/themetoggle.js reads currentTheme (light, dark, auto) and switches the dark style sheet's media: all, not all, or prefers-color-scheme; absent, it writes auto (follows the system), so only light is turned; the theme menu writes it, no reload

docs.rs.note: an inline head script reads rustdoc-theme (light, dark, ayu), light when absent; rustdoc pages of the same origin write it too when they follow the system

en.wikipedia.org.note: signed out, the Appearance menu writes the host-only cookie enwikimwclientpreferences; an inline head script reads it, no reload
the cookie lists several client prefs (%2C); only the day theme is swapped

excalidraw.com.note: the app reads excalidraw-theme at start (light when absent; the system scheme and the theme in excalidraw-state ignored) and writes both back, no reload

fr.wikipedia.org.note: signed out, the Appearance menu writes the host-only cookie frwikimwclientpreferences; an inline head script reads it, no reload
the cookie lists several client prefs (%2C); only the day theme is swapped

gemini.google.com.note: signed out, Settings > Theme writes Bard-Color-Theme; absent, the page follows the system colour scheme

impots.gouv.fr.note: DSFR from a module script at the end of body (no data-fr-scheme from the server): absent, it follows the system and stores the scheme it resolved (light or dark, never system), so a visit under a dark system stays dark under a light one; the recipe owns the key and puts the prior value back, no reload; www checked

service-public.gouv.fr.note: DSFR: the server renders <html data-fr-scheme="light">, the DSFR script reads localStorage scheme (light, dark, system) over it and writes it back, no reload; system already follows a dark system; service-public.fr redirects here, www, entreprendre and lannuaire checked

www.digitec.ch.note: the server renders <html class="digitec light-mode"> when absent, even on a dark system, and dark-mode from .themeshade=dark (light, dark, system); the theme menu sets it HttpOnly and host-only: then the write is refused, one reload, failed

www.galaxus.ch.note: the server renders <html class="galaxus light-mode"> when absent, even on a dark system, and dark-mode from .themeshade=dark (light, dark, system); the theme menu sets it HttpOnly and host-only: then the write is refused, one reload, failed

www.info.gouv.fr.note: DSFR, as on service-public.gouv.fr: data-fr-scheme="light" from the server, localStorage scheme read over it, no reload

www.npmjs.com.note: an inline head script reads npm-color-mode, light when absent; the moon toggle writes it

www.rts.ch.note: a script at the end of body sets body data-dark-mode from rts/feature/darkmode (none when absent; dark, dark-blue, auto), no reload; rts.ch redirects to www.rts.ch
